ValidationRule.description: Date Final Service Order Created must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType_Name__c = "CAC - DP Closure" && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_Final_Service_Order_Created__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Final_Service_Order_Created__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_Final_Service_Order_Created__c) != TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_Final_Service_Order_Created__c)) || DATEVALUE(Date_Final_Service_Order_Created__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Date_Final_Service_Order_Created__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Final_Service_Order_Created__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_Final_Service_Order_Created__c)!= TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date Final Service Order Created must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future.
